guidances.libelle: Accrétion de la croissance de l'ARR (acquisition Arize)
guidances.citation: This guidance reflects the expected contribution from the Arize acquisition, including approximately 200 basis points of ARR growth accretion and 175 basis points of dilution to non-GAAP operating margin for fiscal 2027.

guidances.libelle: Dilution de la marge opérationnelle non-GAAP (acquisition Arize)
guidances.citation: This guidance reflects the expected contribution from the Arize acquisition, including approximately 200 basis points of ARR growth accretion and 175 basis points of dilution to non-GAAP operating margin for fiscal 2027.
We expect foreign exchange to be a headwind of approximately $20 million on ARR and approximately $6 million on revenue for fiscal 2027 compared to ARR and revenue at constant currency.
